title: Chapter 226: Wilderness And Underground Dire Wolves
content:
Chapter 226: Wilderness And Underground Dire Wolves

Wu Qing and the Queen planned the Zerg pioneer army, and the next step was to wait for the energy resources to be mined in the underground world.

The system's gas resources are now very sufficient because of the few cuts Wu Qing made when he quoted the price to the Naga tribe. There is no problem in upgrading such a pioneer army.

Wu Qing almost earned four times the profit from the Naga tribe, and the gas resources earned were enough to hatch four armies of 500,000 Zerg destroyers provided to the Naga tribe.

This is a huge amount of gas resources, which can greatly improve the overall strength of the Zerg. Wu Qing and the Queen need to plan and use it well.

Wu Qing hatched a four-star Zerg man in the Zerg underground world territory, and his consciousness possessed this four-star Zerg man. He wanted to go to the wilderness area of the underground world to take a look.

Wu Qing was very curious about the mysterious underground world.

The Zerg puppies needed for the aboveground world are basically enough. With extra troops, the exploration of the underground world can now begin.

The battle between the Naga and Skeleton tribes still needs some preparation time; the space transmission channel of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce has not been built yet, and it also needs to wait; a large number of Heavenly Silkworm Knights have entered the Southern Free Land, and the collection of information and the promotion of the inheritance of the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations are all very smooth.

Cooperating with the Scottish Fold Cats to explore the battlefield of the camp war near the Zerg territory is not urgent.

Now is a good opportunity to explore the underground world. After a while, Wu Qing may not have time to pay attention to the underground world.

The Zerg puppies guarding the border of the Zerg underground world territory have dealt with many underground creatures that invaded the territory.

These creatures in the underground world have evolved very strangely due to the environment. Wu Qing saw it and could not describe it by analogy with more normal creatures.

The dark environment makes the perception and lurking ability of the creatures in the underground world evolve very powerfully. They often sneak to the edge of the Zerg territory and suddenly attack the Zerg puppies.

Some creatures in the earth world are very strong, and the Zerg has lost some Zerg puppies because of this.

There are dangers in the wilderness area of the underground world, but there are more opportunities. Wu Qing can still accept some losses.

At Wu Qing's order, millions of Zerg puppies quietly entered the wilderness area outside the Zerg underground world territory.

Zerg puppies are also a type of soldier with strong perception and lurking capabilities. When they enter the wilderness area, those underground creatures living in the wilderness area are considered to have met opponents.

Wu Qing's task for the Zerg puppies is to explore, not to sweep and kill. Under normal circumstances, Zerg puppies will not actively attack underground creatures.

Zerg cannot just kill and kill blindly, killing all the underground creatures they encounter, and they will not get any useful information.

After some situations are explored, the underground creatures that have no intelligence and are very aggressive can be cleaned up to ensure the safety of the Zerg underground world territory.

Ordinary and harmless underground creatures can be allowed to live in the Zerg's sphere of influence on their own, just like ordinary animals in the aboveground world.

The intelligent creatures in the underground world must be determined based on good and evil intentions. Races like ghouls that do not conform to Wu Qing's values must be eliminated.

The Zerg puppies explored the wilderness area in detail like a net, and were attacked by creatures from the underground world from time to time.

Some creatures in the underground world are very powerful, and a small number of Zerg puppies are not opponents, so they can only retreat temporarily.

All this information is collected by the Queen of the Worm, and then unified disposal is carried out after the situation is explored.

The area of the wilderness area in the underground world is vast, and the number of Zerg puppies is limited. Such a detailed exploration is very slow.

Wu Qing possessed a four-star Zerg man, and he did not need to explore like a Zerg puppy. He rushed forward quickly, sneaking in the wilderness area that was basically full of rocks and unknown underground plants, and sneaking deep into the wilderness.

With the Zerg's night vision ability and strong perception, Wu Qing discovered many underground creatures. These underground creatures seemed to be able to sense Wu Qing's powerful strength, and they were all lurking, and Wu Qing did not take action against these creatures.

Wu Qing kept going deeper and gradually found some powerful underground creatures. These creatures were basically individuals or small families, and there were very few of them.

Wu Qing felt the threat from these creatures, which meant that the strength of these creatures was at least five-star, or above five-star.

These powerful underground creatures seemed to have a certain wisdom or the ability to perceive danger. The underground creatures that Wu Qing encountered that were stronger than him did not take the initiative to attack Wu Qing.

They did not attack Wu Qing, and Wu Qing did not take the initiative to provoke them. Generally, they avoided them from a distance and only let the Queen of Insects make a good record.

For these powerful creatures in the underground world, how the Zerg will get along in the future needs to be combined with the explored underground world situation and carefully considered before deciding.

The strong will not provoke, and the weak will ignore. Only those evil beasts that act on instinct and attack Wu Qing will be stabbed to death.

These underground creatures can generally only provide a small amount of energy resources and have no value.

Wu Qing kept moving forward quickly, away from the Zerg underground world, until he encountered a ferocious creature that looked like a wolf but covered with bone spurs.

This creature was about the size of a Zerg puppy, and it hunted in groups. Once it sensed Wu Qing, it surrounded him without hesitation, pounced on him, and bit him, treating him as prey.

Wu Qing's spear in his hand shot out like rain, and the underground creatures that rushed up were pierced into the brain by the spear from their blood-red eyes, and were killed in one blow.

"Woo...!"

Those ferocious creatures that did not rush up began to howl, and dense shadows began to appear in the darkness.

"It looks a bit like a wolf, but not quite like it. Instead, it looks a bit like a strange dinosaur!"

"It seems that you are the overlord of the wilderness!"

"Let's call you underground dire wolves!"

Wu Qing gave this ferocious underground creature a name, and then he took the spear and slaughtered the ferocious underground dire wolves.

He found that killing this underground dire wolf would obtain no less resources than the ghoul, so he knew that he had found the real owner.

A creature without the support of a strong tribe cannot provide too much luck. Wu Qing can judge the general situation behind a creature from the amount of qi resources obtained by the system.

Some of the strange creatures that invaded the Zerg territory and were killed by the Zerg puppies can only provide energy resources, and some can provide gas resources, but the amount provided is also very small.

This at least proves that these creatures have no background, and even no wisdom, and they act entirely on instinct.

Such creatures are of no value to the Zerg. Zerg worker bees can earn more by mining a little resource than by slaughtering these creatures.

Wu Qing ran fast and went deep into the wilderness. He was the first Zerg to encounter the underground dire wolf. This underground dire wolf not only has a background, but also has a certain wisdom and organization.

They did not approach the Zerg underground world territory area. They should know that it is the territory of the ghoul clan, and the two clans must have had a confrontation.

Moreover, some time ago, the direction of the Zerg underground world territory was so lively that many creatures with a certain degree of wisdom must have avoided it early.

Hundreds of underground dire wolves surrounded Wu Qing and besieged him. Among them, there were already star-level dire wolves.

Wu Qing did not summon the Zerg puppies, but fought a fierce battle alone, with every shot deadly.

Ants bite elephants to death, which is a golden saying in this world!

As long as there are enough troops, no matter how strong you are, you will be exhausted to death!

So these underground direwolves did not retreat in the face of the powerful Wu Qing, but they did not blindly die, instead of constantly dealing with Wu Qing.

This is different from those stupid races who only know how to charge and kill, and they seem very cunning!

This is the first time that Wu Qing has encountered such an intelligent enemy in this world. In the past, the enemies of the Zerg were either fanatical in belief or racial dignity. Various unknown factors made those enemies fight to the death, making them more Zerg than the Zerg.

Wu Qing helplessly discovered that many of the advantages that the Zerg originally had were normal in this world.

In the early stages of the development of the Zerg, they were always beaten in terms of military advantage and fearlessness, which made Wu Qing very depressed.

Needless to say, the military strength advantage, in terms of fearlessness, because of Wu Qing's intervention, he did not want to consume the loss of troops that consume gas resources, and in this respect, he was not as good as those enemies who did not care about their own losses.

The underground dire wolves have a strong revenge mentality. Wu Qing killed a large number of their own kind, and not even a corpse was left. They were unwilling to retreat, and they were whining and calling for their own kind.

Wu Qing can now be sure that this area is the sphere of influence of the underground dire wolves.

Facing such a temperament of underground dire wolves, other underground creatures here can only become food.

Seeing more and more underground dire wolves gathering, Wu Qing slowly killed the underground dire wolves that kept coming up to test, and asked the queen to collect their information in detail. This race may be the first opponent that the Zerg encounters when they develop the underground world, and they need to pay close attention to it.

When the number of underground dire wolves gathered reached their expectations, they suddenly rushed up and launched a siege on Wu Qing.

Wu Qing's four-star strength was fully unleashed at this time, and he danced the spear in his hand into a flower. Within a few feet, there was no enemy!

With Wu Qing's killing skills, he could easily deal with several more groups of underground dire wolves of this number, so in the middle of the battle, the underground dire wolves were afraid and chose to retreat.

Wu Qing did not pursue. His current location was far away from the Zerg underground world territory. The underground dire wolves' territory should be ahead. It was enough to get this information.

The rest of the things were left to the Zerg Queen to command the Zerg puppies.

Wu Qing turned around again, and returned to the Zerg territory after seeing enough of the novelty of the underground world.

It would take a lot of time for the Zerg puppies to explore the location where he encountered the underground dire wolves. This time, the exploration of the underground world had to be done all at once, and the speed could not be fast.

After such a comprehensive exploration, when necessary, these wilderness areas can be directly incorporated into the Zerg territory.
